policy_notes: Infinity uses an explicit saturated-positive-int32-v1 internal health policy with upper value 2147483647, inferred from current int32 tags and historical community reports; not current official CN numeric calibration. The client visual threshold 1000000 is not used as damage.

END_024 uses original opposing turn_ended secret checks and current positive Health maxima among active live ordinary opposing minions. Highest ties use one uniform physical draw; a unique highest uses no RNG.

Original selected minion references survive reveal/random waiting without rebinding. Damage remains SPELL with Fire school through existing preparation, prevention, actual history, death and reactions.

Per-operation saturation, integer fractions, source conversions and intrinsic Lifesteal are explicit local numeric policies. Attack/Cost infinity consumers remain separate unimplemented real card needs.

record.name: 无穷烈焰
record.text: 奥秘：在对手的回合结束时，对其生命值最高的随从造成无穷大的伤害。
record.text_en: Secret: When your enemy's turn ends, deal INFINITE damage to their highest Health minion.
